Definition: from G3739 with the directive enclitic of source; from which place or source or cause (adverb or conjunction):--from thence, (from) whence, where(-by, -fore, -upon).
BiblicalUsage: hóthen is a plain word for from where, whence. In Matthew 12:44, the text says "I will return into my house from whence I came out."
TheologicalSignificance: I take hóthen as it stands: from where, whence.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
